sources.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 4.5
sources.evidence: Dated October 15, 2025 and announces availability that day. Describes a small, fast model for low-latency assistants, coding, computer use and parallel subagents; distributes it through Claude products and hosted APIs.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 4.5 model overview
sources.evidence: Maps Claude Haiku 4.5 and its convenience alias to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Lists October 15, 2025 release, 200K context, manual extended thinking, and text/image input with text output. Current lineup comparison has no model-parameter counts.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card (October 2025)
sources.evidence: Names Anthropic and its small, fast hybrid reasoning model. Describes extended thinking and 200K context, and evaluates computer use, MCP and general tool use. The searchable card contains no parameter-count or architecture disclosure.

sources.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 interpretability paper. Methods describe transformer residual-stream layers and next-token unembedding; the methods section explicitly applies the analysis to Haiku 4.5 as well as Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5. Haiku 4.5 has its own intervention results. Does not disclose production parameter counts or dense versus MoE structure.

sources.title: Tool use with Claude
sources.evidence: Defines function calling and explicitly lists Claude Haiku 4.5 in its tool-use token table for auto/none and any/tool tool choices.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, including visual content. PDF input is processed using vision; the Haiku 4.5 overview identifies the model as active legacy.

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5 on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: Exact model provider documentation explicitly lists image/PDF/text input, text output, 200,000 input tokens, function calling, extended thinking and October 15, 2025 release.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Terms governing Anthropic API access grant service-use permission, restrict reverse engineering and reserve intellectual-property rights. Supports the descriptive proprietary classification for the hosted model rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Anthropic's Transparency Hub: Claude Haiku 4.5
sources.evidence: Haiku 4.5 section lists Claude.ai, Anthropic API, Bedrock and Vertex AI access and describes pretraining/post-training. It supplies no numerical total or active parameter counts or dense/MoE designation. Later model comparison material provides behavioral evaluation comparisons.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Attempted later sibling card for exact Haiku 4.5 comparison disclosures. Browser fetch failed due to document size; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. Not used as technical evidence.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Attempted later comparison card. Indexed excerpts include Haiku 4.5 behavioral results, but full browser fetch exceeded size limits and direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. Not used to establish numerical model specifications.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 system card
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved the complete 144-page PDF from the working Anthropic redirect and searched its full text. Exact Haiku4.5 comparisons concern behavioral evaluations; parameter terms concern inference controls and do not supply production model counts or dense/MoE topology.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 system card
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved the complete 153-page PDF from the working Anthropic redirect and searched its full text. Exact Haiku4.5 comparisons concern behavioral evaluations; parameter terms concern inference controls and do not supply production model counts or dense/MoE topology.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

name.note: Official name, mapped to the exact dated API snapshot.

developer.note: Developer identified by the launch announcement and system card.

family.note: Catalog slug for the named Claude Haiku product family; retained.

release_date.note: Announcement explicitly says available that day. The 20251001 snapshot suffix is not the public launch date; Bedrock separately lists October 16.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly says Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact Haiku4.5 materials describe hosted distribution; the classification does not rely solely on API access.

license.note: Descriptive classification of restricted hosted-model access, not an SPDX license or a claim that model weights are distributed.

parameters_b.note: No total learned-parameter count disclosed in reviewed exact-model sources or later Haiku5.5 and Opus4.5 cards, both fully retrieved during parent review. Research lens dimensions and inference parameters are not model counts.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count or dense/MoE specification disclosed in reviewed exact-model research and fully retrieved later comparison cards; no sibling transfer or total-equals-active assumption.

architecture.note: First-party interpretability methods describe transformer residual-stream and unembedding computation, then explicitly report Haiku 4.5 experiments. This establishes the broad architecture only; dense versus MoE and complete architectural dimensions remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: 200K tokens for this exact model, confirmed in the system card and current model specifications.

modalities.note: Text/image to text is model-native; PDF is an officially supported input document format processed with vision. Voice dictation and text-to-speech in Claude products do not establish native audio modality.

reasoning.note: Supports manually enabled extended thinking; hybrid reasoning includes a non-thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Exact model is documented for function/tool calling and evaluated with tools.

description.value: Small, fast hybrid reasoning model for coding, computer use, responsive assistants, and parallel subagents.
description.note: Replaces the catalog wording with explicitly supported use cases; classification was not independently established as the intended product positioning in the primary launch materials.

patch.description: Small, fast hybrid reasoning model for coding, computer use, responsive assistants, and parallel subagents.

sources.label: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities

patch.notes: Transformer architecture is supported by first-party interpretability research explicitly studying Haiku4.5. Total/active counts and dense-versus-MoE structure remain undisclosed in the reviewed original and later comparison cards. The dated API suffix precedes the public October15,2025 launch.

summary: Confirmed exact snapshot, October 15 launch, 200K context, text/image/PDF input, text output, extended thinking and tool calling. Added proprietary license classification and broad Transformer architecture from exact-model first-party interpretability research; revised description to primary-supported use cases. Total and active counts remain null, after parent retrieval and full-text checks of both later comparison cards.
